rounds.response:
Bring forward: accelerate a lightweight in‑app referral rollout targeted at younger segments in Q1 and prioritize onboarding friction fixes (one‑tap KYC, simplified auth) plus a regulator‑reviewed consent framework for immediate deployment.  
Push back: defer broad self‑serve lending scale to Q3 and limit Q2 to tightly scoped personalization pilots only for explicit, granular opt‑in cohorts with pre‑approved compliant UX (no defaulted bundles, clear separation of service vs. offers).  
Consent-by-design: require explicit granular opt‑ins with visible rationale, one‑tap opt‑out, and auditable offer logs for every personalized recommendation before any customer-facing pilot.  
Operations sequencing: Q1—minor scripts + 1–2hr frontline briefings; Q2—pilot-specific half‑day upskilling for affected teams; Q3—full retraining aligned to scale.  
Mid‑year success markers to greenlight scaling: 30‑day activation +10–15%, onboarding call volume −15%, pilot opt‑in ≥20%, products per active customer +0.1–0.2, NPS +2–4 pts, and revenue per active user / cost‑to‑serve showing single‑digit improvement trends.
